ios.name: NOVA
ios.subtitle: Health intelligence that knows you
ios.description:
NOVA connects to your smartwatch, learns your personal 28-day baseline, and explains what really changed — before alerting.

• Apple Health: heart rate, HRV, sleep, activity
• Meal context from photos (not a diet app)
• NOVA AI in Hebrew and English
• Blood test tracking
• Breathing exercises for stress

Wellness insights only — not medical advice.
ios.promotionalText: Explain before alerting. Your body, your baseline.
